title: Brazil ordinance 551GC3 on reporting UFOs

tellings.quote: Uh, as of 2009, there was an ordinance called uh uh 551GC3 and it basically any military branch that sees a UFO, they are mandated to give that information to the Central Aerospace Defense Command.

plain: Since 2009, Michels says, a Brazilian rule called Ordinance 551GC3 has required any branch of Brazil's military that sees a UFO to pass the information to the country's Central Aerospace Defense Command. Michels tells this himself, naming the ordinance but quoting none of its words. If so, it would mean Brazil's armed forces treat UFO sightings as something to be formally reported.
